desc: 斗篷式儿童雨衣套图模版：潮萌印花、防水按扣、四色可选
name: 潮萌印花儿童斗篷雨衣款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，白底合规展示斗篷整体廓形
一秒传达潮萌印花与防雨的核心卖点，承接点击
shots.textZone: left panel headline zone reading 「{selling_point_1}」 with one thin-line icon

shots.intent: 放大普通衣服淋雨湿透的痛点，引出雨衣的防护价值
代入真实雨天出行场景，让家长看见孩子穿上的样子
用水珠滚落的面料微距证明防水工艺
展示按扣门襟与帽檐裁剪，证明穿脱方便与做工
用尺寸标注与身高段对照消除买大买小的疑虑
shots.textZone: dimension labels 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 plus an empty spec table with blank cells

shots.intent: 并列展示全部配色款式，让买家一次选对
shots.textZone: one small blank label chip under each poncho reading 「{callout_3}」 「{callout_4}」 「{callout_5}」 「{callout_6}」

shots.intent: 背影挥臂展示斗篷摆动廓形与活动自由度
以留空的印章与参数行承载信任信息，降低决策风险
shots.textZone: right-side row of empty seal frames and blank parameter lines, no pre-filled content

shots.intent: 收口促单，用行动按钮引导立即下单
shots.textZone: rounded CTA button reading 「{callout_7}」 with a short headline 「{selling_point_2}」 above it

style.backgroundSystem: creamy off-white #FAF6EC and soft pink #F5B8C4 studio backdrops, sunny yellow #F7C948 accent panels, clean white #FFFFFF packshot ground
style.iconSystem: simple thin-line icons in single accent color
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio light with front key and gentle fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent playful children rainwear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of creamy off-white #FAF6EC, soft sakura pink #F5B8C4, sunny yellow accent #F7C948 and charcoal text #33383D; bright soft studio lighting with front key and soft contact shadows; rounded modern sans-serif typography; simple thin-line icon style; clean cheerful product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale with the poncho silhouette fully visible; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the product across the set, poncho silhouette always fully visible and unclipped
style.surfaceSystem: matte light board and soft seamless paper, light wood floor for lifestyle scenes
style.typography: rounded modern sans-serif, friendly and legible
